newsitem.title: UK: UK SOCIAL SECURITY BUDGET COULD BE DEVOLVED- FT.
newsitem.headline: UK SOCIAL SECURITY BUDGET COULD BE DEVOLVED- FT.

text.p: The UK's social security budget, representing one third of public expenditure, could be devolved to local regions under proposals being considered by the government, said a report in the Financial Times on Thursday.

Local benefit offices could be freed to run their own budgets if they deliver savings which could be channelled into educational opportunities for claimants, said the report referring to plans under review by Frank Field, the minister in charge of welfare reform.
Field said the changeover could save up to 10 percent of the 100 billion stg annual welfare budget.
The report said the minister was speaking in Exeter during a two week fact finding tour.
